templates.name: Ragtech UPS by SNMP
templates.description: Ragtech Family 10 agent: RFC1628 plus all RAGTECH-UPS-MIB extensions. Numeric OIDs require no MIB installation on the Zabbix server. SNMP v2c interface must be configured on the host. Extensions retain stale samples on disconnection. Power is an estimate, not measured real power.

items.name: UPS detailed: Output Percent Load
items.description: Output load. Source metric: power_out_percent. Divide this value by 100 to obtain percent. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Output Current
items.description: Output RMS current. Source metric: current_out. Divide this value by 100 to obtain amperes. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Output Voltage
items.description: Output RMS voltage. Source metric: voltage_out. Divide this value by 100 to obtain volts. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Input Voltage
items.description: Input RMS voltage. Source metric: voltage_in. Divide this value by 100 to obtain volts. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Output Power
items.description: Output power estimated as voltage times current. Source metric: power_out. Divide this value by 100 to obtain watts. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Input Power
items.description: Input power estimated from output current and input voltage. Source metric: power_in. Divide this value by 100 to obtain watts. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Output Energy
items.description: Accumulated output energy. Source metric: energy_out. Divide this value by 100 to obtain kWh. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Input Energy
items.description: Accumulated input energy. Source metric: energy_in. Divide this value by 100 to obtain kWh. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Temperature
items.description: UPS temperature; sensor location is unknown. Source metric: temperature. Divide this value by 100 to obtain degrees Celsius. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Battery Charge
items.description: Unclamped estimated battery charge. Source metric: battery_state. Divide this value by 100 to obtain percent. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Battery Voltage
items.description: Battery DC voltage. Source metric: battery_voltage. Divide this value by 100 to obtain volts. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Output Frequency
items.description: Output frequency. Source metric: frequency. Returns noSuchInstance when oscillator calibration is unavailable. Divide this value by 100 to obtain hertz. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS detailed: Battery Runtime
items.description: Estimated battery runtime under the current load. Source metric: battery_runtime. Divide this value by 100 to obtain minutes. Retains the last sample while disconnected.

items.name: UPS: Serial connection state
items.description: Current serial communication state. Before the first successful UPS sample this is disconnected. If disconnected, metric and flag extensions are stale and should not be treated as live readings.

items.name: UPS: Last raw response
items.description: Last received UPS response as binary bytes, not a hexadecimal text string. Empty before the first sample; normally 31 bytes for Family 10. Retains the last packet while disconnected.

macros.description: Output load warning threshold in percent.

triggers.name: UPS: Running on battery
triggers.expression: last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.ups.output_source)=5 and last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.ups.connected)=1

triggers.name: UPS: Battery low
triggers.expression: last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.ups.battery_status)=3 and last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.ups.connected)=1

triggers.name: UPS: Battery depleted
triggers.expression: last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.ups.battery_status)=4 and last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.ups.connected)=1

triggers.name: UPS: Output load high
triggers.expression: last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.ups.output_load)>{$UPS.LOAD.WARN} and last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.ups.connected)=1

triggers.name: UPS: Overtemperature failure
triggers.expression: last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.flag.ragtechUpsOvertemperatureFailure)=1 and last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.ups.connected)=1

triggers.name: UPS: Overload failure

triggers.name: UPS: Inverter failure
triggers.expression: last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.flag.ragtechUpsInverterFailure)=1 and last(/Ragtech UPS by SNMP/ragtech.ups.connected)=1

triggers.name: UPS: Short circuit failure
